title: Verify diagnostic printer and visitor parity
description: Phase 5 completed with tests-first red-green TDD: initial 901-case replay had 35 failures and one error; Unicode whitespace characterization later had 18 failures. Fixed exact diagnostic messages and nesting-limit payloads, Unicode caret positions and line endings, AST spelling, mixed byte class ranges, verbose range lookahead and pinned Unicode whitespace, and iterative constant-stack printers. Oracle executes all 21 original Rust error/printer tests and nine native characterization tests; 1,119 exact snapshots and all ten original assertion locations plus two visitor contract audit entries. Gates pass: make format/lint/test (21,517 specs), compile, diagnostic oracle, AST/HIR-construction oracles, 147 native Rust tests, 316 HIR outputs, inventory checks, 22 downstream harness specs.
close_reason: Phase 5 diagnostics, printing and visitor behavior verified; parity plan and inventories updated.

title: Verify literal extraction and UTF-8 parity

close_reason: Phase 4 behavior and assertion audit verified; parity plan updated.
